scope: A live authenticated build for a new Builder project (not on the allowlist) took the legacy path at the 0% universal rollout and failed in 2 seconds: the legacy path writes only to a connected repository and a Builder project has none. Route server-bound Builder runs to the universal path; the operator off, legacy and shadow modes still take precedence, and a missing project id still shadows.

keep: Operator kill switch modes off, legacy and shadow
Percentage rollout and allowlist for non-Builder projects
extend: Server-bound Builder runs route to the universal path

schemaImpact.rollback: Revert the commit and redeploy the previous image.

approval.description: No new authority. The builder binding is still created only by trusted server code after ownership is resolved.

egress.description: No egress change; the line goes to the existing process log only.

cost.description: No change; the iteration cap still bounds model calls.

tests.scope: Builder-bound run is universal at 0% rollout; off, legacy and shadow modes and a missing project id still refuse. 648 PASS, 0 FAIL.

architecture.reason: Adds a limit and a log line to the existing SoftwareAgent executor. No new orchestrator or control plane.

rollout: Merge after required checks, build the release image, create a 0% revision, switch traffic with the Job, then repeat the authenticated build.
rollback: Revert the commit and redeploy; restore the previous service revision and Job image and label.
knownGaps: Preview, QA and external delivery remain separate gates
placeholderClaimsRemaining: Batch 2 building is not accepted until a live authenticated build saves a revision
